repos.name: xerj-org/xerj
repos.description: XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep and sed. One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. Elasticsearch compatible, so existing clients just work.
repos.one_liner: An intelligent data indexing engine designed to optimize AI agent access to large-scale local datasets.
bullets: Built in Rust for high-performance indexing and low-latency retrieval.
Implements auto-indexing capabilities to minimize token waste during agentic data processing.
Designed for developers to provide AI agents with context-aware access to codebases, logs, and documentation.
Replaces traditional grep/sed workflows with semantic-aware search for LLM-driven development.

repos.name: career-ops-hq/career-ops
repos.description: Open-source AI job search agent and job finder: scan job boards, score each job 1-5 against your CV before you apply, tailor an ATS-friendly resume and cover letter, get interview prep and a job application tracker. It helps you fill in each application; you press Submit. Runs locally in your AI coding CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and more).
repos.one_liner: An autonomous AI agent designed to automate the end-to-end job search and application process.
bullets: Utilizes automated workflows to scan job boards and evaluate roles against user CVs.
Features a scoring system (1-5) to prioritize applications based on candidate-job fit.
Generates ATS-friendly resumes and tailored cover letters automatically.
Includes integrated interview preparation modules to streamline the hiring pipeline.

repos.name: Thysrael/Horizon
repos.description: 📡 Your own AI-powered news radar. Generates daily briefings in English & Chinese. | 用 AI 构建你专属的新闻雷达
repos.one_liner: An AI-powered news radar that aggregates and synthesizes daily briefings for professional intelligence.
bullets: Python-based architecture for automated news scraping and data ingestion.
Leverages LLMs to distill high-volume information into concise, actionable daily briefings.
Supports multi-language output, specifically English and Chinese, for global market monitoring.
Ideal for finance professionals tracking sector-specific trends or geopolitical developments.

repos.name: joeseesun/qiaomu-anything-to-notebooklm
repos.description: Claude Skill: Multi-source content processor for NotebookLM. Supports WeChat articles, web pages, YouTube, PDF, Markdown, search queries → Podcast/PPT/MindMap/Quiz etc.
repos.one_liner: A multi-source content processor that bridges diverse data formats into NotebookLM for advanced analysis.
bullets: Python-based toolchain that converts web pages, PDFs, and social media content into structured formats.
Enables the transformation of raw data into podcasts, mind maps, and quizzes via AI.
Acts as a middleware layer to prepare unstructured data for RAG-based knowledge management.
Useful for researchers and analysts needing to synthesize large volumes of disparate information quickly.

repos.name: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
repos.description: Official, Anthropic-managed directory of high quality Claude Code Plugins.
repos.one_liner: The official repository for high-quality plugins designed to extend the capabilities of Claude Code.
bullets: Curated collection of plugins managed directly by Anthropic for enterprise-grade reliability.
Extends the agentic capabilities of Claude by allowing it to interact with external tools and APIs.
Focuses on standardizing the integration layer between LLMs and developer infrastructure.
Essential for developers building agentic workflows that require secure, verified tool access.
